How it runs
  1. This is an individual activity. About 5 minutes to build the story.
  2. Drag pieces onto the story line. On a phone or tablet, tap a piece and then tap a slot.
  3. Keep trying until the story is right. After three tries, you can also ask the facilitator for the code to see the answer.
  4. Then find a partner and tell them the story.
